SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.client_name, projects.location, projects.description, projects.created_at, projects.updated_at 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = $1::UUID

SELECT projectplants.project_id AS projectplants_project_id, projectplants.plant_id AS projectplants_plant_id, projectplants.notes AS projectplants_notes, projectplants.quantity AS projectplants_quantity, projectplants.unit AS projectplants_unit, projectplants.optimum_height_size AS projectplants_optimum_height_size, projectplants.rate AS projectplants_rate 
FROM projectplants 
WHERE projectplants.project_id IN ($1::UUID)

SELECT plants.id AS plants_id, plants.taxon_id AS plants_taxon_id, plants.scientific_name AS plants_scientific_name, plants.common_name AS plants_common_name, plants.category AS plants_category, plants.planting_place AS plants_planting_place, plants.description AS plants_description, plants.common_diseases AS plants_common_diseases, plants.care_data AS plants_care_data, plants.icon_url AS plants_icon_url, plants.image_url AS plants_image_url, plants.created_at AS plants_created_at 
FROM plants 
WHERE plants.id IN ($1::UUID, $2::UUID, $3::UUID, $4::UUID)
